results.fact: Elwha Snowfinger exit: planned route or closed

Current WIC guidance or a 2025 report on the Snowfinger descent would settle it.

results.fact: Ascent vs descent slope on Ferry

One source is not enough to rename the ascent and descent slopes.

NPS gives Sixteen Mile Camp about 3.5 mi below Low Divide (3,600 ft), with the trail starting at 519 ft, but no camp elevation. The peak's 3,800-ft rise in 1.3 mi is measured to the nearest river point, not the ford, so it does not fix the ford's height. No source states the elevation of the camp or ford; bivy[] may not be patched anyway. A topo spot height at the Sixteen Mile ford would settle 1,050 vs 2,021 ft.
